grade_range: Grades 4, 5, 8, lise hazırlık (high school preparatory year) and 9
prerequisites: Application and tracking is done through the T3 Kurumsal Yönetim Sistemi (t3kys.com).
cost_note: Stated as entirely free ('ücretsiz'): 36 months of free technology education.
selection_process: Three stages: (1) E-Sınav (online exam), (2) Çevrimiçi Eğitim & Görev Tamamlama (online training and task completion), (3) Uygulama Sınavı (practical/applied exam).
award_or_output: 36 months of free technology training across 11 different programme titles, delivered at 137 technology workshops in 81 provinces.

research_notes: CATEGORY NOTE: recorded as academic_program, not one of the six named target categories. It is included deliberately — academic_program has only 3 rows in ORYN, it is Turkish, it is free, and it is nationwide, which makes it high-value against this task's stated geographic priority. The ingestion lane may prefer to reclassify. VERIFIED for the 2026 cycle: eligible grades, the 27 January–30 March 2026 application window (now closed as of 2026-08-21), the free 36-month duration, the scale figures, the three-stage selection, and the application portal. NOT VERIFIED and left null: a residency requirement. Search snippets claimed applicants must reside in provinces open for that exam period; that constraint did NOT appear on the page fetched, so it is not recorded as fact — but it is plausible and should be checked before student-facing display. AGE FIT CAVEAT: only the 'lise hazırlık' and grade 9 tracks fall inside ORYN's 14–18 audience; grades 4, 5 and 8 are below it. 2027 cycle dates are not published and are left null.
